data.name: Mashmool
data.gender_notes: Mashmool is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'sh-m-l', meaning 'to soften', 'to make tender'. This name is often given to boys as a symbol of softness and tenderness, as well as a sign of prosperity and joy. The name Mashmool carries the meaning “Soft, Tender, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mashmool usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, tender, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mashmool is a name with deep spiritual significance in Arabic culture. It represents the softness and tenderness of the soul, and the gentle nature of the divine. This name is believed to bring joy and prosperity to those who bear it.
data.etymology: Mashmool belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, Tender, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mashmool total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
